assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original seamless diffuse albedo ground texture for realistic miniature tropical alien jungle terrain. Strict vertical overhead orthographic macro photograph of a 40 centimetre square surface, edge to edge, evenly lit neutral diffuse light. No directional shadows, specular highlights, vignette, perspective, depth of field, text or grid. Fine natural irregular detail, tileable edges, no obvious repeated motif or symmetry. Compacted damp tropical humus, deep muted umber and warm charcoal-brown earth, fine decomposed organic grains, tiny thin root fibres and occasional gritty mineral flecks. Mostly quiet exposed soil with gentle irregular moisture variation. No puddles or standing water, no cracks, no large stones or leaves, no plants, no grass carpet. Detailed matte diffuse colour only, not a black featureless surface.
assets.processing: Original 1024-square PNG converted to WebP quality90. Runtime mipmaps; independently rotated and offset patch sampling without reflection.
